source_annotation.prompt: Pick up the clamp and place it into the container.

generation_prompt: The robot uses the hand entering from the lower-right edge to reach the blue plastic clamp beside the green ball, close its fingers over the clamp body with the thumb beneath, and lift it. It carries the clamp left over the white container's rim, lowers it inside, and opens its hand to release it, then withdraws upright, leaving the clamp resting on the container floor. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
